title: Section 1
context: A man is phoning a community centre to enrol on an evening sports course.

audio.t: Section 1. You will hear a man phoning a community centre to enrol on an evening sports course.
Good afternoon, Riverside Community Centre, Hana speaking. How can I help you?
Oh, hello. I saw your poster for the evening courses, and I'd like to sign up for the beginners' tennis class, please.
Certainly. Let me just open the registration form. Could I take your family name first?
Yes, it's Hargreaves.
Could you spell that for me, please?
Sure. H-A-R-G-R-E-A-V-E-S.
Thank you, Mr Hargreaves. And what's the best number to reach you on?
My mobile is 07700 413 962.
07700 413 962. Is that right?
Yes, that's right.
Lovely. And your address?
It's 22 Pelham Road.
Sorry, could you spell Pelham?
P-E-L-H-A-M. It's in the Westfield area.
Got it. And the postcode?
RH4 7QN.
R-H-4, 7-Q-N. Thanks. Now, I'm afraid I have some bad news about the tennis. The beginners' class is completely full this term.
Oh, that's a shame. I was really looking forward to it.
Well, there's a beginners' badminton class on the same evening, and it still has a few places. A lot of people who miss out on tennis choose that one.
I've never played badminton, but why not? Yes, put me down for that instead.
Great. The first session is on Tuesday the 7th of October.
Oh, good. I thought it would start later than that.
Hold on, sorry. The sports hall is closed that week while they repair the floor. So the first class will actually be on the 14th of October.
The 14th is fine. That gives me a bit more time to get ready.
Now, the poster says the class is at half past seven, but that's the intermediate group. The beginners start earlier, at 6.45, and finish at 7.45.
That's even better for me. I'll be coming straight from work.
The course is eight weeks. The standard fee is 55 pounds, but members get a discount, so it's only 48 pounds.
I joined the centre last year, so I should be a member. Is 48 pounds all I need to pay?

Yes, that covers everything. We provide the rackets and the shuttlecocks. You just need to bring suitable footwear. Most people wear trainers, as long as they have non-marking soles. Please don't wear boots.
No problem. I've got a clean pair I only use indoors.
Perfect. Your booking reference is B-D-4-0-2-8.
B-D-4-0-2-8. Let me write that down.
Oh, I'm so sorry, I read that wrong. It's 4-0-2-6, not 2-8. So B-D-4-0-2-6.
OK, B-D-4-0-2-6. Thanks very much for your help.
You're welcome, Mr Hargreaves. We'll see you on the 14th. Goodbye.

questions.explain: Người nói đánh vần "H-A-R-G-R-E-A-V-E-S" nên đáp án là Hargreaves.
"My mobile is 07700 413 962." Người nghe nhắc lại số và người gọi xác nhận đúng.
"It's 22 Pelham Road" rồi đánh vần P-E-L-H-A-M.
"RH4 7QN" — nhân viên nhắc lại từng ký tự R-H-4, 7-Q-N để xác nhận.
Lớp quần vợt đã đầy ("completely full"), nên anh ấy chọn lớp cầu lông: "put me down for that instead". Tennis là bẫy.

questions.explain: Ban đầu nói ngày 7 tháng 10 nhưng nhân viên sửa: "the first class will actually be on the 14th of October" vì sàn nhà thi đấu đang sửa.
Áp phích ghi 7.30 nhưng đó là nhóm trung cấp; "The beginners start earlier, at 6.45".
Giá chuẩn 55 bảng nhưng thành viên được giảm: "it's only 48 pounds"; anh ấy đã là thành viên từ năm ngoái.

questions.q: Participants should bring clean ______ with non-marking soles
questions.explain: "Most people wear trainers, as long as they have non-marking soles. Please don't wear boots." Vợt và cầu được trung tâm cung cấp.
Nhân viên đọc nhầm "B-D-4-0-2-8" rồi sửa lại: "It's 4-0-2-6, not 2-8", nên mã đúng là BD4026.
